name: Ice Jacket (Yellow to Orange)
note: The heat-sensitive coating turns from yellow to orange as it cools; it is caught here halfway. The blue-to-green one is earlier in the list.

name: Raso Gommato Jacket
note: Military satin bonded with rubber on the inside: stiff, matte and waterproof.

name: Reflective Jacket (Early, Bronze)
note: Glass microspheres on a khaki ground; the silver one is earlier in the list.

name: Liquid Reflective Jacket
note: Each one hand-sprayed with reflective resin, so no two are marked alike.

name: Heat Reactive Jacket
note: Thermo-sensitive: it pales where the body warms it, at the shoulders and chest.

name: Tela Stella Jacket
note: The first Stone Island cloth: truck tarpaulin, stone-washed, red outside and blue inside.

name: Formula Steel Jacket
note: Nylon woven with a stainless-steel thread.

name: David-TC Parka
note: A Japanese star-shaped polyester and nylon cloth, garment-dyed under pressure until it looks like old leather.

name: Shadow Project Articulated Jacket
note: Errolson Hugh's cut: seams shaped to the bent elbow, the badge in black on black.

name: Goggle Jacket (Mille Miglia, Navy)
note: The navy one; the olive Mille Miglia jacket is earlier in the list.

name: Metropolis Jacket
note: From Urban Protection: Dynafil nylon with an anti-smog mask built into the collar.

name: Lens-Detail Sweatshirt
note: Garment-dyed fleece with the lens on the left arm.
